Five Elements Yoga for Balance & Inner Harmony
We are all made up of the five elements of nature - Earth, Water, Fire, Air, and Space. In yogic philosophy, these are known as the Pancha Tatvas or Pancha Mahabhutas.
When these five elements are in balance, we feel healthy, peaceful, energetic, and in harmony with ourselves. When they become imbalanced, it can affect our physical, mental, and emotional health.
